tasks.prompt: Repair wire date validation: impossible calendar dates such as 2024-02-30 must fail, while 2024-02-29 remains valid. Preserve the existing wire contract and add appropriate regression coverage.

Repair signed int64 wire validation at the upper boundary. Reject overflow without converting the value through a lossy JavaScript number. Preserve valid signed 64-bit values and demonstrate both boundaries.
Repair external PostgreSQL configuration for IPv6 URL hosts. The driver needs an unbracketed host. Preserve IPv4, DNS names, explicit ports, TLS defaults and credential redaction.

Repair database connection budget validation. Reserve the migration connection in addition to all runtime replica pools. Preserve runtime minimum pool requirements and the one-connection migration pool.

Repair the pagination oracle verdict when a trace contains both a definite contract violation and incomplete capture. A definite violation must remain visible; incomplete evidence alone must not be presented as a pass. Preserve malformed-input behavior and evidence limitations.
